allow: Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COUNT\(*\) as total_trades, SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as wins, SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as losses, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / NULLIF\(COUNT\(*\), 0\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate_pct, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as total_pnl, ROUND\(AVG\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as avg_pnl, ROUND\(SUM\(fees_usdt\), 4\) as total_fees FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT d.strategy_id, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(p.realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as total_pnl, ROUND\(AVG\(p.realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as avg_pnl, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN p.realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / COUNT\(*\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate, ROUND\(SUM\(p.fees_usdt\), 4\) as fees FROM pnl_ledger p JOIN executions e ON p.execution_id = e.id JOIN risk_approvals r ON e.approval_id = r.id JOIN trading_decisions d ON r.decision_id = d.id WHERE p.is_closed = 1 GROUP BY d.strategy_id ORDER BY total_pnl DESC;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT date\(closed_at\) as day, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as daily_pnl, ROUND\(SUM\(fees_usdt\), 4\) as fees, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / COUNT\(*\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY date\(closed_at\) ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 20;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT date\(exit_time\) as day, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as daily_pnl, ROUND\(SUM\(fees_usdt\), 4\) as fees, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / COUNT\(*\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY date\(exit_time\) ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 20;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT close_reason, COUNT\(*\) as count, ROUND\(AVG\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as avg_pnl, ROUND\(AVG\(holding_time_seconds\), 1\) as avg_hold_secs FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY close_reason ORDER BY count DESC;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT symbol, side, ROUND\(entry_price, 4\) as entry, ROUND\(exit_price, 4\) as exit_p, ROUND\(realized_pnl_usdt, 4\) as pnl, leverage, close_reason, created_at FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 ORDER BY realized_pnl_usdt DESC LIMIT 5;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT symbol, side, ROUND\(entry_price, 4\) as entry, ROUND\(exit_price, 4\) as exit_p, ROUND\(realized_pnl_usdt, 4\) as pnl, leverage, close_reason, created_at FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 ORDER BY realized_pnl_usdt ASC LIMIT 5;")
Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT approval_status, COUNT\(*\) as count FROM risk_approvals GROUP BY approval_status;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT symbol, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as total_pnl, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / COUNT\(*\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY total_pnl DESC;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT strftime\(''%H'', entry_time\) as hour_utc, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as total_pnl, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / COUNT\(*\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY hour_utc ORDER BY hour_utc;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT close_reason, COUNT\(*\) as count, ROUND\(AVG\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as avg_pnl, ROUND\(AVG\(\(julianday\(closed_at\) - julianday\(created_at\)\) * 86400\), 1\) as avg_hold_secs FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY close_reason ORDER BY count DESC;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT strftime\(''%H'', created_at\) as hour_utc, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as total_pnl, ROUND\(CAST\(SUM\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) AS FLOAT\) / COUNT\(*\) * 100, 1\) as win_rate FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY hour_utc ORDER BY hour_utc;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT date\(closed_at\) as day, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as daily_pnl, ROUND\(SUM\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\)\) OVER \(ORDER BY date\(closed_at\)\), 4\) as cumulative_pnl FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY date\(closed_at\) ORDER BY day;")
Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT id, symbol, side, entry_price, quantity, leverage, unrealized_pnl_usdt, created_at FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 0;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT ROUND\(AVG\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN realized_pnl_usdt END\), 4\) as avg_win, ROUND\(AVG\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt <= 0 THEN realized_pnl_usdt END\), 4\) as avg_loss, ROUND\(AVG\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt > 0 THEN realized_pnl_usdt END\) / ABS\(AVG\(CASE WHEN realized_pnl_usdt <= 0 THEN realized_pnl_usdt END\)\), 2\) as profit_factor FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT close_reason, COUNT\(*\) as count, ROUND\(AVG\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as avg_pnl, ROUND\(AVG\(\(julianday\(exit_time\) - julianday\(created_at\)\) * 86400\), 1\) as avg_hold_secs FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY close_reason ORDER BY count DESC;")

Bash("$SQLITE" -header -column "$DB" "SELECT date\(exit_time\) as day, COUNT\(*\) as trades, ROUND\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\), 4\) as daily_pnl, ROUND\(SUM\(SUM\(realized_pnl_usdt\)\) OVER \(ORDER BY date\(exit_time\)\), 4\) as cumulative_pnl FROM pnl_ledger WHERE is_closed = 1 GROUP BY date\(exit_time\) ORDER BY day;")
